title: Frozen Greek Yogurt Berry Crunch Bark
hookLine: High-protein Greek yogurt sweetened lightly with raw honey, swirled with fresh berries & crunchy pistachios.

items.name: Pure raw honey or maple syrup

steps.title: Line Freezer Tray & Prep Mix-Ins
steps.instructionTemplate: Line a rimmed baking sheet or loaf pan with parchment paper so your frozen treat lifts out cleanly. Measure out {yb_yog} and {yb_hon} and keep toppings like {yb_ber} prepped within reach.

steps.title: Spread Thin & Snap Into Bark Shards
steps.instructionTemplate: Whisk {yb_yog} with {yb_hon}, spread onto parchment-lined tray 1/3-inch thick, scatter {yb_ber}, and freeze 2 hours before snapping into shards.
steps.creatorSecret: Use full-fat or 2% strained Greek yogurt so the bark stays creamy instead of icy.

steps.title: Transfer, Smooth Top & Add Garnish
steps.instructionTemplate: Pour or press the mixture evenly into your prepared dish, smoothing the surface with a spatula. Scatter {yb_ber} evenly across the top and press gently so it adheres cleanly.

steps.title: Freeze Solid, Portion & Enjoy
steps.instructionTemplate: Freeze Frozen Greek Yogurt Berry Crunch Bark flat until completely solid, then let sit 3 minutes at room temperature before slicing, snapping, or scooping into 6 servings. Store leftovers in a freezer-safe container.

ugcQuotes.quote: Zero refined sugar and only 135 cal—tastes like total indulgence!
